mapper.select:
select p.prize_log_id, p.member_id, m.phone, p.checkin_id, p.streak_days, p.prize_name, p.won, p.create_time from biz_checkin_prize p left join biz_member m on m.member_id = p.member_id
and p.member_id = #{memberId} and m.phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%') and p.won = #{won} and p.prize_name like concat('%', #{prizeName}, '%')
order by p.prize_log_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_checkin_prize (member_id, checkin_id, streak_days, prize_name, won, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{checkinId}, #{streakDays}, #{prizeName}, #{won}, sysdate())
